entries.prompt: An ASCENSION CORE: concentrated spiritual experience forged into a sacred energy heart for ascending legendary armor. One brilliant round WHITE-GOLD ENERGY NUCLEUS nested inside four thick angular IVORY CERAMIC AND ANTIQUE GOLD protective petals, making a compact broad diamond-like silhouette. The four petals are separate curved claw-like plates embracing the core while leaving its large central face visible. The center glows with a large simple warm golden four-point star, a small turquoise-teal inner halo adds cool contrast. Dark teal shadows between the ivory plates; controlled white-gold light leaks through four broad gaps. Ancient Greek divine craftsmanship, physical and precious, a hefty small artifact, visually more advanced than a holy box. This is neither a rough stone, a cut crystal prism, a ring, a scroll, a pendant nor a floating magic-circle graphic. No long spikes, wings or chains. The large luminous core and four broad ivory-gold petals must remain unmistakable at36pixels.
